newsitem.title: GERMANY: Asian passenger bikes offer unique Berlin tour.
newsitem.headline: Asian passenger bikes offer unique Berlin tour.

text.p: Berlin tourists got a new way of travelling around Germany's capital on Thursday with the launch of an Asian-style rickshaw service.

The three-wheeled bicycles attached to small passenger wagons, normally seen zipping through the streets of cities throughout Asia, will carry patrons past landmarks like the Brandenburg Gate or down the grand Unter den Linden avenue.

Three km (two mile) rides will cost up to five marks ($3). Advertising revenues will also help fund the service. "It is wonderful," said one woman on her first rickshaw ride. "You can see a lot more than you can from a bus and just quietly take it all in."
